# three.js 0.186.1 (vendored)

Unmodified files from the npm package `three@0.186.1` (MIT, see LICENSE), fetched from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/. Only the module, its core file and the post-processing passes the
flow view uses are kept. `SHA256SUMS` pins every file; `tests/test_flow.py` checks them.
Vendored so `raft watch` works offline and Paperraft can serve the same files.
